title: ElevenLabs valuation doubles as voice agents handle 15 million weekly calls
friendlyTitle: Voice agents are now handling millions of customer calls
summary: An employee tender offer valued ElevenLabs at $22 billion, double its February valuation. The company says its voice agents now handle more than 15 million conversations each week across tasks including refunds, insurance renewals and appointment booking.
friendlySummary: ElevenLabs says its AI voice agents manage more than 15 million conversations each week. They help with tasks such as refunds, insurance and appointments.
whyItMatters: Voice agents are moving from demonstrations into routine customer operations. Their scale makes call disclosure, escalation to people, language quality and measurable resolution rates increasingly important purchasing criteria.
friendlyWhyItMatters: More people will speak with AI when they contact a business. Companies should make this clear and provide an easy way to reach a person.
